description: Seed golden roadmap for a US L1B intracompany transfer. The producer (backend/eval/run_outcome_accuracy.py) ASSEMBLES a roadmap from the deterministic ImmigrationRegimeRouter using `profile` below, then grades it against `expected_steps` + `order`. Step matching is by case-insensitive `match` substring against produced step titles (the router emits task_codes as titles). Synthetic — needs human curation against live USCIS L1B requirements.
